description: This file defines the 'PricingRule' class and associated functions for managing pricing rules in an ERP system, including validation, application, and removal of pricing rules, as well as related utility functions.

classes.name: PricingRule
classes.description: Represents a pricing rule with validation and application logic.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the PricingRule instance.

methods.name: validate_duplicate_apply_on
methods.description: Checks for duplicate 'apply_on' entries in the pricing rule.

methods.name: validate_mandatory
methods.description: Ensures mandatory fields are set based on the rule's configuration.

methods.name: validate_applicable_for_selling_or_buying
methods.description: Validates that the rule applies to either selling or buying contexts.

methods.name: validate_min_max_qty
methods.description: Checks that minimum quantity is not greater than maximum quantity.

methods.name: validate_min_max_amt
methods.description: Checks that minimum amount is not greater than maximum amount.

methods.name: cleanup_fields_value
methods.description: Resets fields not relevant based on current configuration.

methods.name: validate_rate_or_discount
methods.description: Validates that rate or discount values are appropriate.

methods.name: validate_max_discount
methods.description: Ensures discount percentage does not exceed maximum allowed.

methods.name: validate_price_list_with_currency
methods.description: Checks currency consistency between price list and rule.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Validates date fields for the rule.
